title: Training apps for athletes
why: Training data helps you improve steadily and avoid injury from doing too much too soon.
what_is_different: Athletes need the right zones, honest logging, attention to recovery and sleep, and a plan that peaks for key events.
starter_project: Set up your zones, log four weeks honestly, and build a peak-and-taper plan for your next event with your coach.

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
